notes: Effect specification of Abe Sapien (F07 step 4, data only) in DSL v1 (docs/effects-dsl.md): no engine code reads it yet.

Texts copied from the real cards of sheet 194 of the tournament save (2026-10-28); where unmatched-memory differs, the card wins and it is noted in `discrepancies`. Migrated to the canonical schema on 2026-10-28 without changing the semantics.

A fighter defeated by the previous `damage` no longer moves (selectors are alive by default). Moving a rival fighter is directed by the effect's owner (chooser owner), which is what used to be called push.

Ivan's decision (28/10): agents: 3 on the board; summon = revive a defeated one with 1 life in Abe's zone or, with none defeated, take a living one and place it on a space of Abe's zone (Secure The Scene).
Ivan's decision (28/10): Uncanny Intuition: also activates a token when Abe defends and deals combat damage to an adjacent attacker.
Ivan's decision (28/10): Perfect Shot: any value from 0 to 7 can be predicted; if the rival does not defend with a card, it does not hit.
Ivan's decision (28/10): Every Possible Angle against the bot: the bot lays its hand face up (row at look_spot, like F16) and pings the cards.
Ivan's decision (28/10): Counterhex Shield: the real text (with ONGOING) is also corrected in unmatched-memory.

ability.text:
UNCANNY INTUITION
You have two Intuition tokens.
When Abe deals combat damage to an adjacent fighter, activate a token.
When Abe is attacked, if you have an active token, deactivate it, then draw 1 card, and the attack is played face up.
ability.notes: It fits in primitives: a token counter (0..2; faces: inactive dark, active green with yellow stripes) plus draw and reveal. The plan foresaw the abe:uncanny_intuition plugin; it is not needed. 'Combat damage' excludes effect damage (Concussion Device) and only counts what Abe deals, not the agents. 'When Abe is attacked' does not fire when an agent is attacked. The draw happens before choosing the defense, so the drawn card can be the defense.

cards.title: Faster. Stronger.
cards.text: IMMEDIATELY: Move Abe up to 2 spaces. AFTER COMBAT: Gain 1 action.
cards.notes: Attack by Abe only. The immediate movement can break adjacency before resolving (a rival Arcane Dampener will already have resolved at the same time: both IMMEDIATELY, the defender first).

cards.title: Advanced Psychometry
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: If the opposing fighter is adjacent, look at your opponent's hand.
cards.notes: Hidden information: see hidden_info. Adjacency measured after the combat (if the rival died in it, there is no adjacent fighter: it is not looked at).

cards.title: Perfect Shot
cards.text: You may play this card face up and predict the printed value of your opponent's card. DURING COMBAT: If you predicted correctly, add +2 to this card's value.
cards.notes: The plugin's `predict` step does NOT really run in IMMEDIATELY: it hooks the moment of playing the card (before the rival chooses), where the owner decides whether it goes face up and, if so, announces a printed value. The DSL has no 'when played' moment nor 'save a prediction and compare it', and it is the only card of the box that needs it: hence the plugin. Played face down it is a normal attack 3 with no effect.

cards.title: Secure The Scene
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Summon a B.P.R.D. Agent in Abe's zone. Move a friendly fighter up to 2 spaces.
cards.notes: Only an agent plays it. 3 agents on the board, 0 in reserve. Ivan's decision (28/10): 'summon' returns a defeated agent with 1 life to Abe's zone; if none is defeated, the owner takes a living one and places it on a space of Abe's zone. The placed agent can be the one chosen to move.

cards.title: Leap Away
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: If you won the combat, choose one of the fighters in the combat and move them up to 4 spaces.
cards.notes: If the chosen one is the rival, the effect's owner moves it. A fighter defeated in the combat cannot be chosen.

cards.title: Concussion Device
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Deal 2 damage to an adjacent opposing fighter and move them up to 3 spaces.
cards.notes: Adjacent to the fighter that played the card. It is not combat damage: it does not activate an intuition token. If the damage defeats it, it does not move (the bound selector only returns living fighters).

cards.title: Arcane Dampener
cards.text: IMMEDIATELY: If the opposing fighter is adjacent, subtract 3 from the value of your opponent's card.
cards.notes: The value does not drop below 0 (general rule).

cards.title: B.P.R.D. Training
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Draw 1 card. Move each friendly fighter up to 2 spaces.
cards.notes: Up to 4 physical movements in a row; the owner does them in the order they want (and may skip some).

cards.title: Shock And Awe
cards.text: DURING COMBAT: If your fighter began this turn in a different space, this card's value becomes 4. AFTER COMBAT: Your opponent discards a card.
cards.notes: 'Becomes 4' fixes the printed value at 4 (it does not add): later bonuses (Utility Belt +1) apply on top. It needs to remember each fighter's space at the start of the turn; played in defense during the rival's turn it also counts (a prior push counts). The discard is chosen by the rival: the bot does not see its hand, only the card that falls.

cards.title: Cold Iron And Holy Water
cards.text: IMMEDIATELY: Your opponent can not gain actions or draw cards this turn.
cards.notes: It blocks rival AFTER COMBAT effects such as 'Gain 1 action' or 'Draw 1 card' in this combat and for the rest of the turn (including the maneuver if the turn is the rival's). It does not block the draw at the start of the next turn.

cards.title: Ward And Prepare
cards.text: IMMEDIATELY: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card. AFTER COMBAT: Return a scheme from your discard pile to your hand.
cards.notes: Pure defense. If there are no schemes in the discard, nothing.

cards.title: Every Possible Angle
cards.text: Look at an opponent's hand and choose a card. Put it on top of their deck. Move Abe up to 3 spaces.
cards.notes: Abe-only scheme. With the rival's hand empty the choice is skipped and Abe moves anyway. Double hidden information: see hidden_info (the hand and the next card the rival will draw).

cards.title: Counterhex Shield
cards.text: Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action. Ongoing: Other players' effects can't damage your fighters, move your fighters, or force you to discard cards. Discard this at the start of your next turn.
cards.notes: DISCREPANCY: unmatched-memory only has 'Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action.'; the real card adds the Ongoing. It blocks only rival EFFECTS (Concussion Device, Hellboy 'Horseshoes...', Medusa gaze...), not combat damage. It is discarded at the start of the next own turn: the scheme stays on the table until then. Before it was a status with a blocks list; now three separate statuses.

cards.title: B.P.R.D. Utility Belt
cards.text: Add +1 to your next attack this turn. A friendly fighter recovers 1 health. Move a friendly fighter up to 1 space. Gain 1 action.
cards.notes: Abe-only scheme. The +1 is consumed by the first own attack of the turn (of any own fighter) and expires at the end of the turn. Healing does not exceed max life.

plugins.why: When playing the card (before the rival chooses) the owner decides whether it goes face up and, if so, announces a printed value; during the combat it is compared with the printed value of the rival card and adds +2. Neither a 'moment when played' nor 'save and compare a prediction' exist in the DSL and it is the only card of the box that uses them. For the bot, the prediction is an AI decision (the known rival hand or the searcher's hand model).

hidden_info.what: look_hand of the rival after the combat if still adjacent
hidden_info.bot_rule: The bot reads the human's hand only at that instant (Game.observe_hand -> KnownHand), remembers it and discounts it as cards leave the hand (card_left_hand). If Abe is the human's, the bot shows its hand (the cards are laid face up in TTS or dictated by chat) and hides it again.

hidden_info.what: look_hand + choose a card and put it on top of the rival's deck
hidden_info.bot_rule: Like Advanced Psychometry, and in addition the bot knows which is the next card the rival will draw: KnownHand needs a known 'top_of_deck' that moves to the hand on the next draw (extension of the 'look at the hand' step). If Abe is the human's, the human chooses and the bot only records that a card of its hand went to the deck (it no longer has it; it will draw it later).

hidden_info.what: attack played face up at will
hidden_info.bot_rule: If the bot plays it face up it announces it (title and value) and the prediction before the human defends. If the human plays it face up, the bot reads that card because the card says so; nothing else of the hand.

hidden_info.what: the attack against Abe is played face up if a token is spent (reveal attack_card)
hidden_info.bot_rule: Bot with Abe: asks the human to put the attack face up and reads it before choosing a defense; draws 1 before choosing. Human with Abe: the bot announces its attack card before the human defends. The human's draw is theirs and the bot does not see it.

hidden_info.what: the rival discards a card of their choice
hidden_info.bot_rule: The bot does not look at the hand: it only sees the card that falls into the discard (public) and discounts it from KnownHand if it had seen it.

hidden_info.what: recover a scheme from the own discard
hidden_info.bot_rule: Public information (the discard); if the human does it, the bot notes that this card returns to the rival's hand (it enters KnownHand as seen).

open_questions: 6. Agent tokens in TTS: they are called Victor, Carla and Kate; the engine numbers them agent1..agent3. The fid -> GUID mapping is needed in the game configuration (step 10 of the plan), like the Harpies.
Every Possible Angle: how the engine records the bot's card that returns on top of its deck (it becomes known to the human: it does not affect the bot's information).
